headlines.summary: 직방, 지난달 실거래가 분석 지난달 수도권 아파트 시장에서 15억 원 초과∼20억 원 이하 거래 중 신고가 비중이 절반을 웃돈 것으로 나타났다. 11일 부동산 플랫폼 직방이 국토교통부 아파트 실거래가 자료를 분석한 결과 지난 7월 수도권 아파트 가격대별 신고가 비중은 6억 원을 넘어선 구간에서 1년 전보다 상승 폭이 커진 것으로 조사됐다.

headlines.title: 韓 수도권 부동산 쇼핑하던 중국인 항복?… 외국인 매수 2000명 확 줄어든...

headlines.summary: 순익 초과분에 20% 세율 적용 ‘손실 이월공제’ 적용안돼 논란 “반등해도 손해인데 세금까지 내라고요?” 가상자산 투자자들 사이에선 손실 중인 가상자산이 해를 넘겨 일부 반등하더라도 여전히 마이너스(-)인데 세금까지 내야 하느냐는 불만이 나오고 있다.

headlines.title: 국내 상장사 18%, 내년 상폐 위험
headlines.summary: 동전주 등 기존조건 미달 192곳 내년 기준 상향되면 479곳 해당 부실기업을 솎아내기 위한 상장 폐지 규정이 강화된 지 한 달이 지난 가운데, 국내 상장사의 7.4%가 시가총액 기준에 미달한 것으로 나타났다. 규정이 더 강화되는 내년엔 상장사 다섯 곳 중 한 곳이 상장 폐지에 내몰릴 수 있다는 분석도 나왔다.

headlines.title: "韓 경제 반도체 중심 개선세 확대 "… KDI , 성장 평가 상향
headlines.summary: 수출·소비 동반 반등에 '개선세 확대' 진단 한 달 만에 경기 판단 상향…생산·투자 껑충 고물가·고용 둔화, 美관세·중동 불안은 뇌관 [세종=이데일리 하상렬 기자] 국책연구기관인 한국개발연구원(KDI)이 우리 경제가 반도체를 중심으로 ‘개선세가 확대’되고 있다고 진단했다.

headlines.title: 순풍에 돛 단 반도체 덕 … 2분기 수출 2천755억달러로 역대 최대

key_headlines.title: Q2 Exports Hit Record 275.5 Billion Dollars on Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's second-quarter exports reached an all-time high of $275.5 billion, driven by semiconductor industry surge with electrical and electronic products accounting for $160.4 billion or 58% of total exports.

key_headlines.title: Foreign Real Estate Purchases in Seoul Drop Sharply, Especially from China
key_headlines.summary: Foreign property purchases in the Seoul metropolitan area fell by 2,000 people over the past year under the foreign land transaction permit system, with 73% of the decline attributed to Chinese buyers.

key_headlines.title: Honam Semiconductor Fab Targeted for Completion by 2029
key_headlines.summary: Minister Kim Jeong-gwan announced the government aims to complete the first phase of the Honam semiconductor manufacturing facility by 2029, with plans to establish a dedicated organization within the year.

key_headlines.title: Korea Development Institute Raises Growth Outlook on Semiconductor-Led Recovery
key_headlines.summary: The Korea Development Institute upgraded its economic assessment, citing broadening improvement driven by semiconductors and recovery in exports and consumption, though noting inflation and employment remain concerns.

key_headlines.title: Reconstruction Projects Increase Seoul Housing Supply by 12,000 Units Over Five Years
key_headlines.summary: Analysis of reconstruction projects in Seoul's major districts shows net housing increases of 51.3%, contradicting concerns about limited housing supply effects from redevelopment initiatives.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic momentum is driven primarily by the semiconductor industry's remarkable performance in the second quarter. Export revenues reached a record $275.5 billion, with electrical and electronic products comprising $160.4 billion or 58% of total exports. The semiconductor boom is reshaping Korea's export concentration, with the top 10 companies now accounting for 55.3% of exports, the highest level on record. However, this heavy reliance on semiconductors raises structural concerns about economic diversification and vulnerability to sector-specific downturns.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea's monetary policy committee members are signaling a potential for continued interest rate increases as economic data supports tightening measures. Officials note that second-quarter GDP growth exceeded expectations and core inflation remains elevated, with semiconductor industry gains translating into wage and inflation expectations. The central bank Deputy Governor emphasized that without specific shocks, additional rate hikes remain probable, though concerns exist about demand-side inflation pressures spreading beyond the semiconductor sector. The government is monitoring August economic indicators closely to determine the trajectory of future monetary policy decisions.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean stock markets rallied with the Kospi and Kosdaq rising together, primarily supported by semiconductor and cosmetics export strength. The won-dollar exchange rate weakened slightly to 1,415.9 won, reflecting modest currency pressures. Stock mutual funds experienced significant outflows during the first half of the year, with net assets declining by 65 trillion won as investors shifted toward safer bond investments. U.S. interest rate expectations eased, with September FOMC rate hold probability now exceeding rate hike probability for the first time in a month, providing relief for growth stock valuations.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung SDI announced it will acquire General Motors' stake in their joint battery venture Synergia Cells, moving to full independent operation of the Indiana manufacturing facility. Chinese electric vehicle manufacturers maintain significant cost advantages through 30% cheaper battery production compared to Korean producers, creating competitive pressure in the EV market. Critical raw material prices surged dramatically, with copper rising 45% and cobalt up 57%, driven by increased demand from electric vehicles and AI infrastructure amid supply constraints from South America snowstorms and Congo export restrictions. The government is exploring policy measures to restore overseas investment capabilities for critical mineral sourcing.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment rental market shows an unprecedented shift with monthly rental contracts surpassing 55% of the market share for the first time, reflecting the accelerating transition from jeonse to monthly rent arrangements. Foreign property purchases in the Seoul metropolitan area declined sharply by 2,000 buyers, with Chinese investors accounting for 73% of the decrease following the implementation of foreign land transaction permit restrictions. Apartment reconstruction projects demonstrate stronger housing supply effects than commonly assumed, with completed projects in major Seoul districts showing net increases of 51.3% in housing units. The government faces ongoing debate regarding new housing supply policies, including contentious proposals to develop apartments in protected green spaces.
sections.International Economy: U.S. monetary policy expectations shifted as investors reassess Federal Reserve rate trajectories, with September FOMC pause probabilities now exceeding hike expectations. The Bank of Japan faces pressure to raise interest rates amid weakening yen despite joint intervention efforts with the United States, creating potential divergence in monetary policies between major central banks. Concerns persist about currency instability and financial stability risks as policy divergence widens between the Federal Reserve and Bank of Japan. Political uncertainties in the United States, including assassination threats affecting presidential security protocols, add complexity to global economic outlook assessments.
sections.AI & Economy: Maeil Business Newspaper partnered with FN Guide to develop artificial intelligence-based financial and investment agent services, targeting launch by year-end with natural language processing capabilities for investment analysis. AI technology is increasingly being leveraged by fintech companies to solve corporate challenges, including document automation for business efficiency, security risk minimization, and alternative financing solutions for small business receivables. The integration of AI into financial services represents a competitive advantage for long-term fintech survival and growth potential in increasingly digitalized markets.
sections.Others: Lotte Group agreed to sell its Lotte Rental subsidiary to U.S. private equity firm TPG for approximately 1.3 trillion won, representing the company's second attempt after a previous deal with Affinity Equity Partners was blocked by the Fair Trade Commission in January. Intel announced its first-ever equity offering to raise approximately 21 trillion won for artificial intelligence investments and financial restructuring under new CEO Pat Gelsinger. Labor disputes emerged at Naver Jet with wage negotiations stalling as subsidiary employees protest differential treatment compared to parent company compensation policies. The government plans to establish an 'talent and education account' within the Future Response Fund to address education finance structural reforms.
